answer: Launching a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand stakes slashed on detection, a current too strong for any river of clones. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks collateral proportional to its reputation, and peers attest only after sustained honest work, so fake identities sink to a value nadir. Honest agents cross that river to an oasis of trust, where attestation weight compounds with tenure and each new identity starts at zero. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
